name: Kandai Touji
source:
An old friend of Tsutsui's, he is a priest at a Zen temple in Kamakura, but is an eccentric man who is devoted to the Bible. 
[spoiler]In the latter half of the story, Tsunakawa and the girls take shelter there.[/spoiler]
